preparedFields.accessesPersonalInformation: Yes — user-selected project files and their metadata may contain personal information; optional local MCP clients can access the model. No automatic developer analytics or project upload.
preparedFields.certificationNotes: Desktop 3D mesh modeler. No login, subscription, external server or network connection is needed for core modeling. Test with keyboard and mouse. Create a rectangle in the viewport, select geometry and use Extrude; example project files are also included in the portable release. JavaScript objects, GLSL shaders and procedural objects are user-authored modeling features. Optional MCP is disabled until started in settings and binds only to 127.0.0.1; external agent clients and services are separate. The interface is English; Store descriptions and captions are localized. The app needs graphics drivers supporting OpenGL 3.3 and DirectX 11.
